patterns.what_worked: The FrameXML mirror and the client DB settled every client-behaviour question. Revert-to-fail proofs caught vacuous pins. The two live lanes were scoped to disjoint file sets so they cannot collide.
patterns.what_was_hard: The operator reports client-visible symptoms in his own words, and I repeatedly answered in the wrong frame (character frame vs tooltip) and guessed instead of dispatching a lane to read the code. I called the tree publish-ready while two client-visible behaviours were still unverified.
patterns.skill_gap: The first briefs of this session omitted the four-skill protocol, and I did not keep my own desk trail while the release ran.
